## QC Long Reads
```{bash}
# sequali --outdir outputs/sequali_reports data/Data_2026/saccharomycesParadoxus2026.fastq
# sequali --outdir outputs/sequali_reports data/Data_2026/saccharomycesBayanus2026.fastq
```

## Assembly using Flye 
```{bash}
# flye --nano-raw data/Data_2026/saccharomycesParadoxus2026.fastq --out-dir outputs/flye_output/saccharomycesParadoxus2026 --threads 8 --genome-size 12m
# flye --nano-raw data/Data_2026/saccharomycesBayanus2026.fastq --out-dir outputs/flye_output/saccharomycesBayanus2026 --threads 8 --genome-size 12m
```

## Running Medaka
```{bash}
# saccharomycesParadoxus2026
# Round 1
# medaka_consensus -i data/Data_2026/saccharomycesParadoxus2026.fastq -d outputs/flye_output/saccharomycesParadoxus2026/assembly.fasta -o outputs/medaka_output/medaka_round1/saccharomycesParadoxus2026 -t 8
# Round 2
# medaka_consensus -i data/Data_2026/saccharomycesParadoxus2026.fastq -d outputs/medaka_output/medaka_round1/saccharomycesParadoxus2026/consensus.fasta -o outputs/medaka_output/medaka_round2/saccharomycesParadoxus2026 -t 8

# saccharomycesBayanus2026
# Round 1
# medaka_consensus -i data/Data_2026/saccharomycesBayanus2026.fastq -d outputs/flye_output/saccharomycesBayanus2026/assembly.fasta -o outputs/medaka_output/medaka_round1/saccharomycesBayanus2026 -t 8
# Round 2
# medaka_consensus -i data/Data_2026/saccharomycesBayanus2026.fastq -d outputs/medaka_output/medaka_round1/saccharomycesBayanus2026/consensus.fasta -o outputs/medaka_output/medaka_round2/saccharomycesBayanus2026 -t 8
```

## Evaluating the assembly using BUSCO 
```{bash}
# saccharomycesParadoxus2026
docker run --rm \
-v "$PWD":/data \
-w /data \
ezlabgva/busco:v6.0.0_cv1 \
# busco -i outputs/medaka_output/medaka_round2/saccharomycesParadoxus2026/consensus.fasta -o outputs/busco_output/saccharomycesParadoxus2026 -l saccharomycetaceae_odb12 -m genome -c 8


# saccharomycesBayanus2026
docker run --rm \
-v "$PWD":/data \
-w /data \
ezlabgva/busco:v6.0.0_cv1 \
# busco -i outputs/medaka_output/medaka_round2/saccharomycesBayanus2026/consensus.fasta -o outputs/busco_output/saccharomycesBayanus2026 -l saccharomycetaceae_odb12 -m genome -c 8


```
